summary: Document solo-maintainer ownership and a concise recovery checklist
details: Record the sole maintainer's release, security and emergency patch authority with a private recovery checklist.
Record current solo-maintainer controls and Pages settings while retaining unknown package, domain-recovery and independent-backup access as explicit gaps.
